messages.subject: Hierarchical Modeling Workshop
parts:
Dear unmarked users,

 Bob Dorazio is offering a workshop on hierarchical modeling that should be of interest to unmarked users.
 Please see the attached announcement.
 This emphasizes Bayesian analysis (at a technical level) and I think covers some concepts related to classical likelihood analysis. Please email Bob directly for further information.
 
regards,
andy
